notes.title: Whisperwind Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We've made the following changes to whisperwind:
- Changed the splash screen
- Changed the link on the "about" section
- Updated to a newer Unity version
- Minor optimizations

Thank you and STAY PUNX!

Our website

notes.title: Whisperwind Update v1.3
notes.notes:
- Added language buttons to select it instead of using Steam's language
- Changed the splash screen to a newer logo
- 50% off this week!

notes.title: Whisperwind update - v1.2
notes.notes:
- Introduced the Brazilian Portuguese as a new language available!
- Small changes to the puzzles
- Small bug fixes

notes.title: Whisperwind update - v1.1
notes.notes:
- Changed the "Good ending" so that it reveals a bit more of the story of Whisperwind
- Made some changes to the maze to make it easier to navigate and removed softlocks
- Now you can skip the credits
- Gravity now still applies if you're interacting with an object
- Remade the animation that played on one of the endings
- Now you can't input the code on the nursery door before triggering the gas
- Alt won't turn off the flashlight anymore (you can alt + tab with no worries now!)
- Changed the location of the hint for the Lockdown puzzle
- Corrected a visual bug on the UI of the "About" section on the main menu
- Small bug fixes

The next update will introduce Brazilian Portuguese as a new language available!
